title: Number bonds to 10
examples: Can you show me the pairs that make ten?
If I have 3, what number do I need to make 10?

explain.say: Look at the picture. You will find pairs of numbers that make ten.
Hold up two fingers. You need eight more fingers to make ten.
You have five blocks. You need five more blocks to make ten.
Count up from three to ten. That is seven more. Three and seven make ten.
Number bonds help in real life. You have ten stickers. You give three away. Seven are left.
The order can change. Two and eight make ten. Eight and two make ten too.

faq.a: With whole numbers there are six pairs. They are 0 and 10, 1 and 9, 2 and 8, 3 and 7, 4 and 6, and 5 and 5.
asks: Can you name some pairs for ten?

faq.q: Does the order of the numbers change the answer?
faq.a: No, the order does not change the answer. Two plus eight is the same as eight plus two.
asks: Is 2 plus 8 the same as 8 plus 2?
Does order matter when adding to ten?

faq.q: What is the easiest way to learn these pairs?
faq.a: Using your fingers or drawing dots can help you see the missing number. It is a fun way to learn.
asks: How can I remember all the pairs?
Can I use my hands to learn this?

faq.q: Do I have to learn all of them at once?
faq.a: No, you can learn them slowly over time. Practice makes these number bonds easy to remember.
asks: Is it okay if I forget some pairs?
How long will it take to learn this?

faq.q: What if the total is not ten?
faq.a: If the total is not ten, we are finding number bonds to that new number. We can learn them next.
asks: What if we want to make 12?
Can we do this for other numbers?

facts: The number 10 is a key number for number bonds.
Every number up to ten has a partner to make ten.
Each pair adds up to ten, like one and nine.
Adding the same number twice makes a special pair, like five and five.

quiz.say: What goes with four to make ten?
quiz.why: Four and six make ten. Count up from four: five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten.

wrong.0: Four and five make nine, so you need one more.
wrong.2: Fourteen is four add ten, but you need to reach ten.

quiz.say: You have seven apples. How many more make ten?
quiz.why: Count up from seven: eight, nine, ten. That is three more.

wrong.1: Seven and two make nine, so you need one more.
wrong.2: Seventeen is seven add ten, but you need to reach ten.

quiz.why: Two and eight more make ten.

wrong.0: Two and seven make nine, which is one short of ten.
wrong.1: Six and five make eleven, which is one too many.
